_comment: Measurements from the manual/HUD pipeline that are NOT paired-seed effects (so not docs/claims.jsonl). One line per measurement; recompute with the named script. Keep this honest: a number without its artefact is not a measurement.

what: Battletoads level 1 HUD reads 6/6 bar and 3 filled + 2 empty hearts on the spawn frame
recheck: uv run python scripts/hud_hearts.py --image runs/knowledge/bt_video/f_00880.png

what: One hit on level 1 empties a heart (3 filled -> 2) while the bar stays 6/6
recheck: see runs/knowledge/hud_by_level/survey.json

what: ContraJ menu: manual arm (START from prior) reaches play at frame 480; prompt-only obeys a SELECT reading and never enters; blind_sparse (old pulse schedule) enters at 840
recheck: uv run python scripts/menu_polygon.py --game ContraJ-Nes-v0 --frames 1200

what: Battletoads menu: intro is ~3600-5000 frames; blind_sparse (10 pulses) never enters within 5500; blind_dense and manual enter at 2040
recheck: uv run python scripts/menu_polygon.py --game Battletoads-Nes-v0 --frames 5500 --arm manual

what: ContraJ prior carries 10 schema-v2 facts, 6 with a page a person can open; door-position and capsule are route notes marked extracted
recheck: uv run python scripts/validate_prior.py assets/priors/prior_ContraJ-Nes-v0.json

what: Contra US manual (gamesdatabase OCR): 7/7 gold facts extracted, recall 1.0, precision 0.5 against empty-schema and raw-OCR baselines
recheck: uv run python scripts/parse_manual.py score --parsed manuals/parsed/contra_us.json --gold assets/priors/gold/contra_us.json --page-text manuals/parsed/contra_us_text.txt
note: First real-PDF parse measurement. Baselines: empty schema recall 0; raw OCR recall 1.0 (quote_hints sit in the text by construction). Precision 0.5 counts 5 extras (dpad, select-weapon, underwater) and 2 wrong-page hits.

what: Contra Japanese manual (Rx2.0, jpn OCR): scroll-modes recovered; eight-directions and fire-left live in a graphic control table that OCR cannot read
recheck: uv run python scripts/parse_manual.py extract --pages manuals/pages/Contra_J --game ContraJ-Nes-v0 --out manuals/parsed/contra_j.json  # then score with page_offset=1
note: First real Japanese-PDF parse. OCR (jpn+eng) reads prose but not the graphic control table. PDF page = printed page + 1. Contra US text manual recovers fire-left and 3d facts from prose instead.

what: Vice Project Doom manual (Rx2.0, OCR): 6/7 gold facts, recall 0.86, precision 0.75 — beats the raw-OCR baseline (recall 0.57)
recheck: uv run python scripts/parse_manual.py score --parsed manuals/parsed/vice.json --gold assets/priors/gold/vice_j.json --page-text manuals/parsed/vice_text.txt
note: First parse that beats raw-OCR baseline. Misses fire-weapon (B button label in a graphic). OCR typo tolerance (100 Cains = 1 extraman) needed for extra-man.

what: Chip n Dale Rescue Rangers (held-out A): parser recall 0.1 (1/10) vs raw OCR 1.0 — rules overfit to dev wording
recheck: uv run python scripts/parse_manual.py score --parsed manuals/parsed/chipndale.json --gold assets/priors/gold/chipndale_us.json --page-text manuals/parsed/chipndale_text.txt
note: First held-out parse score. CapCom wording (Press A to jump / Press B to pick up) is not covered by rules written for Contra/Vice.

what: Galaga (held-out B): parser recall 0.0 (0/8) vs raw OCR 1.0 — complete miss of Bandai wording
recheck: uv run python scripts/parse_manual.py score --parsed manuals/parsed/galaga.json --gold assets/priors/gold/galaga_us.json --page-text manuals/parsed/galaga_text.txt
note: Second held-out parse score. A and B fire missiles / challenge every third level / retrieve captured fighters — none matched. Raw OCR finds all 8 by quote_hint.

what: LLM lexicon on Chip n Dale (held-out A): recall 1.0 precision 1.0 vs regex 0.1 / raw OCR 1.0
recheck: uv run python scripts/llm_lexicon.py score --parsed manuals/parsed/chipndale_llm.json --gold assets/priors/gold/chipndale_us.json --page-text manuals/parsed/chipndale_text.txt
note: LLM lexicon (MiMo as the model behind the prompt) recovers every Capcom-specific fact the regex missed. Schema and scoring unchanged from the freeze.

what: LLM lexicon on Galaga (held-out B): recall 1.0 precision 1.0 vs regex 0.0 / raw OCR 1.0
recheck: uv run python scripts/llm_lexicon.py score --parsed manuals/parsed/galaga_llm.json --gold assets/priors/gold/galaga_us.json --page-text manuals/parsed/galaga_text.txt
note: LLM lexicon recovers every Bandai-specific fact the regex missed, including challenge-every-3 and boss-two-hits.

what: Manual-assisted zero-shot on Chip n Dale (held-out A): planner+prior median 239 vs planner no-prior median 92, +144 px, wins 19/20, paired bootstrap CI [109, 145]. Equals BC alone (239) at h=48, where no-prior needs h=96 to reach 234.
recheck: python -c "import json; ..."  # paired best_x by seed 5000-5031
note: The manual contribution is the crate-combat templates (pick up + throw right/up) from page 8 of the Capcom manual. Without them the same planner scores 92 at h=48. Schema, scoring and success criterion unchanged from the freeze. This is held-out A: the pipeline author did not tune on Chip n Dale before this run.

what: Manual-assisted zero-shot on Galaga (held-out B): planner+prior 81 vs planner no-prior 81 vs BC 81. No effect from the manual. 15 paired seeds, CI [-0, 2] includes zero.
recheck: paired best_x by seed 5000-5031
note: Score metric = white pixels at y62-78 x215-240 (player score, NOT the HIGH SCORE block). All arms score ~81 because the BC policy barely hits enemies. The manual facts (boss-two-hits, challenge-every-3) do not translate into in-horizon score. Honest negative for B; the claim rests on A.

what: Contra J TAS (mars608,aiqiyou) reaches position 3072 (the jungle wall) in 4000 frames, then the level resets to 0. Reference for what optimal play achieves.
recheck: replay the fm2 and read game_pos every 200 frames
note: TAS shows the jungle wall is reachable in ~4000 frames of optimal play. Our planner also reaches 3072. The position metric is validated by the reference.

what: Galaga with BC 0.913 (15-min agent-play data) + proxy-reward px=50: planner+prior 81 vs no-prior 81 vs BC 82. Diff 0, CI [0, 0], 0/10 wins. Clean structural negative.
recheck: paired best_x by seed 5000-5031
note: Final Galaga result. Even with BC that scores (val 0.913) and proxy-reward for flashes, the manual adds nothing. The action-result window (fire→hit→score) exceeds any tested horizon. This is a property of the game, not of the pipeline.

what: Galaga h=256 with combat reward and Galaga templates: oracle median 85 vs BC 81. Oracle wins ALL 6 paired seeds. Median diff +3, CI [2, 4]. First time the planner beats the policy on Galaga.
recheck: oracle_mpc --horizons 256 --proxy-reward --combat-px 30
note: The action-result window analysis predicted this: fire to hit to score is 60-120 frames. At h=256 the planner can finally see it. Galaga-specific templates (track-and-fire, aligned-barrage) and combat reward help, but the horizon is the key.

what: Self-imitation online adaptation on Chip n Dale: 3 rounds x 4 rollouts. Mean progress 16.2 → 30.7, max 55.9 → 84.0. The policy improves during play.
recheck: uv run python -c "from nes_player.policy.improve import self_imitation; self_imitation(runs/bc_chipndale, ...)"
note: Stage 9 of the MVP: online adaptation during play. The policy fine-tunes on its own successful rollouts. Round 1 dips (overfitting to the first round); round 2 recovers and exceeds.

what: LLM lexicon on Kung-Fu Heroes (held-out C): recall 1.0 precision 1.0 vs raw OCR 0.56. Third game at 1.0.
recheck: uv run python scripts/llm_lexicon.py score --parsed manuals/parsed/kungfuheroes_llm.json --gold assets/priors/gold/kungfuheroes_us.json
note: Culture Brain beat-em-up. Searchable PDF text layer. Facts: punch, Moon Sault Kick, 8 castles, enter door.

what: LLM lexicon on Pac-Man (held-out D): recall 1.0 precision 1.0 vs raw OCR 0.875. Fourth game at 1.0.
recheck: uv run python scripts/llm_lexicon.py score --parsed manuals/parsed/pacman_llm.json --gold assets/priors/gold/pacman_us.json
note: Tengen Pac-Man. Searchable PDF. Facts: dots, ghosts, energizer, combo 200-1600, fruit bonuses, 10k extra life.

what: Kung-Fu Heroes (held-out C): oracle+prior 247 vs BC 242 at h=128. Median diff +4, CI [2, 43], 5/10 wins. Positive, marginal.
note: Moon Sault Kick and punch templates from the manual. Beat-em-up genre. Positive but only 5/10 wins — not as clean as Chip n Dale.

what: Pac-Man (held-out D): oracle+prior 28 vs BC 28 at h=128. Diff 0, CI [0, 0], 0/10. No effect.
note: Single-screen maze. Score metric reads from top-right. Pac-Man needs path planning, not template combat. The manual describes rules, not sequences the planner can use in-horizon.
